notes.title: New CARDS & ABILITIES for the Card Draw Demo!
notes.content:
Hey there, Valdis here )/

Another content update for the Card Draw demo was just released for Steam Next Fest.

This major update introduced a lot of new cards and abilities! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45230712/6b9958d7a4d434735b8389eeb0b2c3f77170e02d.jpg

You can now play DRAW cards, ACTIVATION cards, ABILITY VALUE cards, and lots of new ability types.


 Cards with a DRAW symbol scale up throughout a run based on the number of times the cards themselves were drawn from your deck;
 Cards with an ACTIVATIONS symbol instead scale up throughout a run based on the number of turns the card was active on the table;
 Cards with ABILITY VALUES symbols randomly select the ability value of one of your equipped abilities and use it to calculate the points for your cards equation;
 Lots of new abilities were introduced too to allow you to find new exciting strategies to get even higher scores.

The update also introduced some balancing changes, fixed minor bugs/typos, and made some cards/abilities descriptions easier to understand.

Smaller balancing, quality of life and bugfix updates for the Card Draw demo will be coming soon too, so stay tuned!

Play the Card Draw demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261300

- Valdis

notes.title: New IDLE mode for the Card Draw Demo!
notes.content:
Hey there, Valdis here )/

A major update for the Card Draw demo was just released for the Steam Idler Fest.

This major update introduced a brand new game mode: IDLE MODE!

In IDLE mode, cards are drawn automatically from your deck while you do other things. Your goal is simple: reach one quadrillion points (10^15). How long will you take? Hours? Days? Weeks? 
You can take your time or be as fast as possible to enter the new IDLE mode leaderboard.

The update also introduced some minor bugs/typos fixes.

More content and balance updates for the Card Draw demo are coming soon too, so stay tuned!

Find the Card Draw demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261300

- Valdis
